entries.title: Manage Breakdowns from Workshop
entries.description: Review reports, photos and locations, assign Mechanics, and track repairs through to Solved. See other open Breakdowns on the same Job to coordinate repairs in one visit.

entries.title: Record services and set the next service due
entries.description: Record workshop visits with dates, hour readings, Mechanics and notes. Closing a service updates Next Service Due, with alerts when servicing is due soon or overdue.

entries.title: Review fleet history in one place
entries.description: View readings, Breakdowns and services together on a Machine, or Breakdowns on an Implement. History filters respect the records you can access, so unavailable saved filters no longer hide results.

entries.title: Understand photo upload problems
entries.description: Rejected uploads now explain invalid details or photo limits instead of showing a general failure.

entries.title: Keep edits safe during autosave
entries.description: Background updates during a save no longer cause newer edits to be mistaken for saved changes. Text you are still typing waits for the normal save action.

entries.title: Report and follow Breakdowns
entries.description: Report a Machine or Implement problem with urgency, photos and typed or spoken notes. Use the new Workshop tab to follow repairs and exchange notes.

entries.title: Check a Machine’s maintenance status
entries.description: See when servicing is due soon or overdue, alongside the Machine’s open Breakdowns.

entries.title: Follow voice recording progress
entries.description: The voice field border animates while recording and transcribing, and Android phones vibrate when recording starts. The listening indicator stops when the recording limit is reached.

entries.title: Understand voice note and upload failures
entries.description: Silent voice notes now say that nothing was heard instead of reporting transcription as unavailable. Rejected uploads give clearer reasons, including photo limits.

entries.title: Reopen in your last-used business
entries.description: The app remembers which business you last used and opens there while you still have access.

entries.title: Pull to refresh across tabs
entries.description: Pull down on a main tab list to refresh app data. Only the list you pulled shows the refresh spinner, keeping other lists in place.

entries.title: Recognise temporary server failures
entries.description: Temporary server failures now show as server errors instead of confusing response-reading errors.
